_comment: This site has moved to https://salimos.cc/zenith, which is now the canonical
home of the landing page, the privacy policy and the support page. What is
left here is a redirect, so the old address keeps working and the two copies
stop competing for the same search results.
Deploying this needs TWO more things done by hand, in this order:
1. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on the SalimOS Vercel project. Without it the
new pages emit canonical and sitemap URLs pointing at localhost, and
redirecting traffic to a page Google cannot canonicalise is worse than
leaving this one up. Do not deploy this file before that is fixed.
2. Change the Play Console listing's Website field to the new address, and
EXPO_PUBLIC_PRIVACY_URL in the app to https://salimos.cc/zenith/privacy.
app-ads.txt is served from salimos.cc/app-ads.txt now (AdMob reads it from
the ROOT of the listed domain, never from a subdirectory). It is empty until
there is a publisher id; see app/app-ads.txt/route.ts in the SalimOS repo.
